text:
sam: Heads-up — starting onboarding for `tempest-22b` now. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/tempest/22b/v1/weights.tar. Need quick alignment on tokenizer quirks + RoPE/GQA/MQA compatibility before canary. Planning a 10% canary tomorrow 09:30. ping @maya + @jin for checks.

maya: quick note — saw inconsistent token counts for emoji/unicode on the sample corpus. Example: `tokenizer.encode('👍') -> 2` on the current tokenizer artifact, should be 1. Likely normalization issue (NFC vs NFKC). Repro: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('tempest-tokenizer.json').encode('👍').ids)"`

jin: ran config-lint locally: `./tools/config-lint --model=tempest --path s3://redwood-models/tempest/22b/v1` -> errors:
```
ERROR: attn_impl mismatch: model declares `gqa=true` but config.attn_impl=seq_chunk -> not supported for GQA.
ERROR: rope_scale missing for rotary when using MQA/GQA mixed heads.
```
Need to pick attn_impl that supports both or rely on runtime fallback.

lisa: also saw kv_cache drift in long-context smoke (50k tokens) on the last run — kv-miss rate jumped to 6% after 40k tokens. Might be sliding-window off-by-one in the adapter. I'll monitor during canary.

arjun: proposed canary plan:
- deploy 1 node canary (reserved) + 3 warm standby
- runtime config: `quantization: nf4_8bit`, `attn_impl: scaled_rope`, `rope_alpha: 1.0` (tunable)
- routing: 10% traffic for 30m, metrics: p50/p95 latency, kv-miss rate, token/sec, tok/cost.
Fallback: route to 13b_variant if attn/runtime errors.

maya: tokenizer patch ready, PR #1427 — normalizes input with `unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text)` before pre-tokenize. Quick local check: `pytest tests/tokenizer/test_unicode.py::test_emoji_count` passes. Will link PR.

jin: runtime change needed — when model metadata indicates mixed GQA/MQA head maps, runtime must compute rotary scale per-head or use unified `rope_scale` override. Added unit test `tests/runtime/test_rope_scaling.py` and a guard that rejects `attn_impl=seq_chunk` for GQA. I'll open runtime PR after CI.

ci-bot: smoke pipeline kicked off: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/14732 (smoke + tokenizer + runtime-lint). Logs will appear in ~10m.

ops-bot: canary window scheduled for 2026-03-18T09:30Z -> 10:00Z, alert policy `canary-critical` attached.

sam: sounds good. @lisa can you own watch during the canary (latency, kv-miss, tokenization regressed examples)? If anything >5% kv-miss or p95 regresses >50ms, rollback.

lisa: on it. I'll stream perf dashboard and set a Grafana alert for kv_miss_rate > 5%. Also will tail runtime logs for `KV_CACHE` WARNs.

maya: small heads-up — tokenizer change may alter token counts for billing-sensitive routes. Added a migration note in PR and a small eval mapping old->new token deltas for common prompts.

arjun: once runtime + tokenizer PRs are green, I'll update the model manifest:
```
model: tempest-22b
weights_uri: s3://redwood-models/tempest/22b/v1/weights.tar
tokenizer: s3://redwood-models/tempest/22b/v1/tokenizer.json
config:
  quant: nf4_8bit
  attn_impl: scaled_rope
  rope_scale: 1.0
  gqa: true
```
Then trigger `./infra/deploy_model --manifest manifests/tempest-22b.yaml --env canary`.

jin: note to reviewers — check `attn_impl` compatibility matrix in the runtime README. If we can't make a single impl support the model, runtime will fallback to `gqa_variant` which is slightly slower (~8% p95).

sam: final ask — please add a short bullet in PR descriptions about expected perf delta and tokenization delta. We'll reconvene after canary ends.

lisa: will paste canary summary in this thread when done.

arjun: thanks all, tagging this as `onboard:tempest-22b` in infra and will add to rollout calendar.

ci-bot: smoke tests passed for tokenizer and config-lint (2/2). Runtime lint pending.
